title: A股港股早报：夜盘指数温和转正，黄金与生物科技出现反转信号 + 美股盘前：油价冲击与零售指引施压，Nordson和精选科技逆势
summary: QQQ、SPY、DIA夜盘ETF代理温和转正；Moomoo行业panel的10只代表股逐项复核为3项确认、3项潜在反转、4项背离或不可得。A/H以本地量价为主，山东黄金强势但黄金夜盘广度降温，快手财报后显著承压。 标普期指近乎持平、道指期指跌0.1%、纳指期指涨0.1%；布油升至约93.90美元、10年期美债约4.68%。Walmart强季度却因谨慎指引盘前跌逾6%，Alibaba云收入增45%但利润和自由现金流承压；Nordson、加密平台与部分AI权重呈现相对强势。

A ticker-by-ticker check of the 10 Moomoo panel representatives produced three confirmations, three potential reversals and four divergences or unavailable prints. Local A/H price and volume take precedence: Shandong Gold remains strong, gold breadth cooled overnight, and Kuaishou weakened sharply after earnings.
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
阿联酋暂停对伊朗贸易，霍尔木兹能源尾险再升
美联社8月19日报道，阿联酋在称再遭伊朗导弹袭击后暂停与伊朗全部贸易；战前阿联酋占伊朗进口逾30%，且近两周已有多艘阿联酋油轮在海峡受袭。事实层面继续支撑油价与上游能源，利空航运、航空和高估值成长。
国际
美加接近贸易协议，50%关税威胁暂缓
美联社称美加接近敲定贸易协议，原定50%的美国关税有望避免，但关键条款仍未完全明确。风险偏好边际改善，工业、汽车和大宗供应链得到喘息；若谈判反复，外需与人民币敏感资产仍会承压。
科技
Moomoo行业全榜揭示贵金属领涨、硬件承压
新任务会话成功抓取Moomoo美股行业榜全部145个行业：白银涨10.98%、黄金涨9.23%、焦煤涨8.65%、贵金属与采矿涨8.39%，而半导体设备与材料跌4.16%、计算机硬件跌5.16%。A/H优先映射黄金、贵金属与焦煤，科技硬件仍看低开承接。
科技
Marvell上涨9.85%，Google定制芯片合作重塑ASIC竞争
Marvell宣布覆盖AI推理加速、网络、存储和近存计算的Google合作，并向Google授予最多5897万股认股权证；股价涨9.85%，Broadcom反跌4.61%。A/H正映射在高速互连、CPO和定制算力，验证信号是中际旭创、海光信息能否强于芯片指数。
科技
韩国KOSPI下跌5.8%，亚洲存储与AI硬件拥挤度暴露
美联社确认韩国KOSPI下跌5.8%、日经225下跌3.2%，反映以三星电子和SK海力士为核心的AI/存储拥挤交易仍在出清。A股存储、设备和服务器链不宜仅因美股指数反弹追高，需看外盘止跌与北向/机构成交。
科技
癌症疫苗三期事件带动医药科技逆势爆发
Moderna与Merck公布黑色素瘤研究积极初步结果，Moderna上涨177%、Merck上涨12.6%。这不是A/H同类公司业绩，但对创新药、mRNA和临床里程碑交易形成情绪映射；A/H仅关注有真实管线与数据披露的公司，避免概念追涨。
财报
小米二季度环比修复，今日再涨约3.50%延续正反馈
小米官方披露二季度营收1089.22亿元，同比下降6.1%、环比增长9.9%；调整后净利62.19亿元，同比下降42.6%、环比增长2.4%。01810.HK在11:17 CST报28.40港元，较昨收27.44港元涨约3.50%，价格继续认可环比改善，仍需验证利润率。
财报
港交所纪录业绩获温和正反馈
港交所官方披露上半年收入及其他收益167.02亿港元，同比增长19%；归母利润105.68亿港元，同比增长24%；每股盈利8.36港元、每股中期息7.43港元。00388.HK在11:17 CST报415.60港元，较昨收414.60港元涨约0.24%，成交反馈偏正但不强。
财报
快手营收略超预期但价格反馈转弱
Futu财报日历显示快手二季度营收355.35亿元，略高于预期354.90亿元；EBIT为37.57亿元，略低于预期38.04亿元。01024.HK在11:17 CST报33.42港元，较昨收37.80港元跌约11.59%，按风险与观察处理，不纳入多头推荐。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
夜盘指数：三大ETF代理温和转正，纳指代理领先
Futu OpenD实时订阅于2026-08-20 11:17 CST（约08/19 23:17 EDT）显示：QQQ（纳指100代理）+0.407%、SPY（标普500代理）+0.118%、DIA（道指代理）+0.041%。这些是夜盘ETF代理而非指数期货；源未标示延迟，API未单列逐笔时间。
板块对照
板块对照：黄金和生物科技潜在反转，硬件压力内部背离
逐项复核panel代表股：EXK +0.090%、HL +0.243%、DQ -0.071%为确认；HYMC -0.035%、MRNA -5.476%、BTCT +113.935%为潜在反转（BTCT个股事件性强，不代表硬件行业普遍反转）；AMR、MLAB、REFR、PASW不可得/无成交，归为背离且无法确认。总体是3项确认、3项潜在反转、4项背离/不可得。
A/H映射
A/H映射：指数偏多但黄金广度降温，优先相信本地量价
温和转正的QQQ/SPY/DIA代理有利于A/H风险偏好，但HYMC与MRNA夜盘反向、四只代表股无成交，说明隔夜强势并未全面确认。运行时山东黄金涨约8.21%、小米涨约3.50%，而快手跌约11.59%；短线以本地成交为主，山东黄金若守住25.36港元开盘价则贵金属映射有效，跌回23.88港元昨收或QQQ转负则失效。

盘前结论

Moomoo现金行业榜中的硬件压力尚未解除：10只代表股夜盘仅DQ延续负向确认，BTCT虽大涨却属个股事件性潜在反转，另有四只无成交，不能据此判断科技硬件全面反转。QQQ、SPY、DIA三只夜盘ETF代理均温和上涨，叠加山东黄金运行时涨约8.21%、小米涨约3.50%，支持A/H选择性风险偏好。

板块对照为3项确认、3项潜在反转、4项背离/不可得，短线应优先相信A/H本地量价：贵金属看山东黄金能否守住25.36港元开盘价，成长链则需QQQ保持正值并等待CPO与国产算力放量确认。

快手跌约11.59%、金山软件跌约3.83%，而金山云涨约8.01%，显示港股科技财报继续分化。若QQQ转负、山东黄金跌回23.88港元昨收，或MRNA夜盘反转向创新药扩散，则降低进攻仓位；否则维持资源与业绩兑现方向的选择性配置。

重点个股推荐

小米集团
01810.HK
业绩正反馈

推荐理由：二季度营收与调整后净利均环比改善，汽车、AI及新业务收入同比增长17.1%，次日股价涨约6.95%。

触发因素：若开盘后守住27港元附近并继续强于恒生科技，可确认资金认可环比修复。

风险点：收入和调整后净利同比仍降6.1%和42.6%，新业务经营亏损26亿元，追高需防利润率再定价。

香港交易所
00388.HK
纪录业绩验证

推荐理由：上半年收入及利润创纪录，归母利润同比增长24%，中期息同比提升至7.43港元。

触发因素：若00388.HK高开后成交放大且不回补大部分缺口，可确认本地金融权重正反馈。

风险点：部分投资收益含非经常性估值收益，若市场成交回落，利润弹性可能被下修。

中际旭创
300308.SZ
CPO订单映射

推荐理由：Marvell与Google合作覆盖AI推理、网络和存储，高速互连是A股最直接的正向映射之一。

触发因素：低开后成交缩量、收复开盘缺口并强于通信设备指数，才视为资金承接。

风险点：SOXX、Broadcom与设备股普跌，若AI资本开支估值继续下修，CPO难以独立走强。

海光信息
688041.SH
国产算力分化

推荐理由：Google扩大定制芯片伙伴说明ASIC需求仍强，国产算力具供应链独立与本地订单逻辑。

触发因素：科创芯片止跌、海光放量强于寒武纪与中芯国际，并获得订单或政策验证。

风险点：Broadcom、AMD、Lam Research同步下跌说明行业估值压缩仍可能覆盖国产替代叙事。

山东黄金
01787.HK
黄金行业映射

推荐理由：Moomoo全榜中黄金行业涨9.23%、52只成分全线上涨，且贵金属与采矿涨8.39%，为A/H黄金股提供最直接隔夜映射。

触发因素：现货金与沪金保持强势，01787.HK高开后成交承接并相对恒指走强。

风险点：贵金属已处涨幅前列，若美元反弹或避险溢价回吐，高开追涨可能快速回撤。

板块轮动看板

受益方向黄金、白银与贵金属采矿、焦煤，以及港交所和高成交金融；资源链优先验证行业广度。
观察方向小米汽车与AI业务、国产算力、平台互联网，以及10年期收益率下降后的成长股承接。
压力方向计算机硬件、半导体设备与材料、电子元件、存储及GPU；韩国AI硬件拥挤交易仍在出清。
验证信号现货金/沪金与山东黄金量价、SOXX映射链、小米能否延续、00388.HK业绩缺口及10Y是否守住4.64%附近。

逻辑链

美国财政部扩大长债回购使10年期收益率降至4.64%，美股指数止跌，为A/H估值提供边际支持。
Moomoo全榜显示白银涨10.98%、黄金涨9.23%、贵金属与采矿涨8.39%，资源避险成为隔夜最强主线。
同一全榜中半导体设备与材料跌4.16%、计算机硬件跌5.16%，与SOXX下跌共同确认科技硬件压力。
A/H映射分成山东黄金等贵金属进攻，以及CPO、国产算力和港股权重的低开承接验证。
若金银价格与A/H黄金股同步放量，资源主线可延续；若贵金属冲高回落且硬件继续放量下跌，降低追涨并转向现金流防御。

风险雷达

芯片拥挤交易扩散

SOXX跌2.21%，Broadcom、AMD、设备股普遍下跌，可能压制A/H高估值硬件。

中东能源升级

阿联酋暂停对伊朗贸易与海峡袭击会推高油价、通胀和亚洲进口成本。

小米利润率反复

环比改善获价格认可，但同比利润降幅大且汽车AI新业务仍亏损。

港交所非经常收益

纪录业绩包含未上市股权估值收益，成交降温会削弱盈利持续性。

贵金属冲高回落

黄金、白银和贵金属采矿已居行业榜前列，美元反弹或避险降温会放大高开回撤。

数据来源与时间点

来源：Moomoo美股行业榜（新任务会话于2026-08-20 10:39 CST抓取，页面显示08/19 22:33 ET；完整核验145行业、98涨47跌）；Futu OpenD实时订阅的QQQ/SPY/DIA及10只panel代表股夜盘字段（行情时间约08/19 23:17 EDT，抓取于08/20 11:17 CST；无延迟标记，API未单列逐笔时间）；Futu HK/SH/SZ财报日历、NOTICE搜索及港股快照（抓取于11:15—11:17 CST）；AP关于8月19日美股收盘、美债回购、10Y收益率、KOSPI/日经、癌症疫苗、美加贸易及阿联酋—伊朗局势；小米与港交所官方业绩公告。
entries.html_en:
Major News Summary
Global
UAE suspends Iran trade as Hormuz energy tail risk rises
AP reported on Aug. 19 that the UAE suspended all trade with Iran after renewed missile fire; before the war it supplied more than 30% of Iran's imports, and several UAE tankers have been attacked in the strait over the past two weeks. The facts support oil and upstream energy while hurting shipping, airlines and long-duration growth.
Global
US and Canada move toward a deal as the 50% tariff threat eases
AP said the US and Canada moved closer to a trade agreement that could avert threatened 50% tariffs, although key terms remain unresolved. This modestly helps industrial, auto and commodity supply chains; renewed friction would still pressure export- and renminbi-sensitive assets.
Tech
Moomoo's full industry ranking shows precious metals leading and hardware lagging
The new task session retrieved all 145 industries in Moomoo's US ranking: silver rose 10.98%, gold 9.23%, coking coal 8.65%, and other precious metals and mining 8.39%, while semiconductor equipment and materials fell 4.16% and computer hardware 5.16%. A/H maps first to gold, precious metals and coking coal, while hardware still needs support after a weaker open.
Tech
Marvell jumps 9.85% as Google custom silicon reshapes ASIC competition
Marvell announced a Google partnership spanning AI inference accelerators, networking, storage and near-memory compute, plus warrants for up to 58.97 million shares. MRVL rose 9.85% while Broadcom fell 4.61%. The positive A/H read-through is high-speed interconnect, CPO and custom compute, tested by Innolight and Hygon outperforming chip benchmarks.
Tech
Korea's KOSPI drops 5.8% as Asian memory crowding is exposed
AP confirmed the KOSPI fell 5.8% and the Nikkei 225 lost 3.2%, showing that crowded AI and memory trades centered on Samsung and SK Hynix are still unwinding. A-share memory, equipment and server names should not be chased solely because US indexes bounced; overseas stabilization and institutional volume are needed.
Tech
Cancer-vaccine Phase 3 event sparks a biotech surge
Moderna and Merck reported encouraging initial melanoma-study results; Moderna soared 177% and Merck gained 12.6%. This is not an A/H earnings result, but it lifts sentiment around innovative drugs, mRNA and clinical milestones. Only A/H companies with real pipelines and disclosed data merit attention; concept chasing remains risky.
Earnings
Xiaomi extends its positive response with a roughly 3.50% gain
Xiaomi reported Q2 revenue of RMB108.92 billion, down 6.1% year over year but up 9.9% sequentially; adjusted net profit was RMB6.22 billion, down 42.6% year over year and up 2.4% quarter over quarter. At 11:17 CST, 01810.HK traded at HK$28.40 versus a HK$27.44 prior close, up about 3.50%; price continues to reward the sequential improvement, while margins still need proof.
Earnings
HKEX record results receive a mildly positive response
HKEX reported record first-half revenue and other income of HK$16.70 billion, up 19%, and attributable profit of HK$10.57 billion, up 24%. EPS was HK$8.36 and the interim dividend HK$7.43. At 11:17 CST, 00388.HK traded at HK$415.60 versus a HK$414.60 prior close, up about 0.24%; the response is positive but modest.
Earnings
Kuaishou slightly beats revenue expectations but price feedback weakens
Futu's earnings calendar shows Kuaishou Q2 revenue of RMB35.535 billion versus RMB35.490 billion expected, a slight beat, while EBIT of RMB3.757 billion was just below RMB3.804 billion expected. At 11:17 CST, 01024.HK traded at HK$33.42 versus a HK$37.80 prior close, down about 11.59%; treat it as a risk/watch item, not a long recommendation.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight indexes
Overnight indexes: three ETF proxies edge higher, with the Nasdaq proxy leading
A Futu OpenD real-time subscription snapshot at 2026-08-20 11:17 CST (about Aug. 19 23:17 EDT) showed QQQ, the Nasdaq-100 proxy, up 0.407%; SPY, the S&P 500 proxy, up 0.118%; and DIA, the Dow proxy, up 0.041%. These are overnight ETF proxies, not index futures; the source showed no delay flag and the API provided no separate per-trade timestamp.
Sector check
Sector check: gold and biotech signal potential reversals while hardware pressure diverges
Ticker-by-ticker checks found EXK +0.090%, HL +0.243% and DQ -0.071% confirming their panel direction; HYMC -0.035%, MRNA -5.476% and BTCT +113.935% signaled potential reversals. BTCT is highly idiosyncratic and does not imply a broad hardware reversal. AMR, MLAB, REFR and PASW were unavailable or had no overnight trade, so they are divergences that cannot confirm the panel. Total: three confirmations, three potential reversals and four divergences/unavailable.
A/H mapping
A/H mapping: indexes lean positive but gold breadth cools; local volume leads
Positive QQQ/SPY/DIA proxies support A/H risk appetite, but opposite overnight moves in HYMC and MRNA plus four names without trades mean the cash-session strength lacks broad confirmation. At runtime, Shandong Gold was up about 8.21%, Xiaomi about 3.50% and Kuaishou down about 11.59%. Prioritize local trading: the precious-metals mapping holds if Shandong Gold stays above its HK$25.36 open; a retreat to the HK$23.88 prior close or QQQ turning negative invalidates it.

Pre-Market Conclusion

Hardware pressure in Moomoo's cash-session industry panel is not resolved: among 10 representatives, only DQ extended the negative direction overnight; BTCT's surge is an idiosyncratic potential reversal, and four names had no trade. That is insufficient to call a broad tech-hardware reversal.All three overnight ETF proxies—QQQ, SPY and DIA—edged higher, while Shandong Gold was up about 8.21% and Xiaomi about 3.50% at runtime, supporting selective A/H risk appetite.

The panel comparison produced three confirmations, three potential reversals and four divergences/unavailable. Prioritize local A/H price and volume: precious metals need Shandong Gold to hold its HK$25.36 open, while growth needs QQQ to stay positive plus volume confirmation in CPO and domestic compute.

Kuaishou fell about 11.59% and Kingsoft about 3.83%, while Kingsoft Cloud rose about 8.01%, showing continued earnings dispersion in Hong Kong tech. Reduce offensive exposure if QQQ turns negative, Shandong Gold falls back to its HK$23.88 prior close, or MRNA's overnight reversal spreads to innovative drugs; otherwise retain selective exposure to resources and delivered earnings.

Why: First-half revenue and profit hit records, attributable profit rose 24%, and the interim dividend increased to HK$7.43.

Trigger: A higher open that holds most of its gap on expanding volume would confirm positive feedback in Hong Kong financials.

Risk: Part of investment income reflects non-recurring valuation gains; lower market turnover could reduce earnings leverage.

Eoptolink
300308.SZ
CPO order mapping

Why: Marvell's Google deal spans AI inference, networking and storage, making high-speed interconnect a direct A-share read-through.

Trigger: A weaker open followed by lighter-volume stabilization, gap recovery and outperformance versus telecom equipment would confirm support.

Risk: SOXX, Broadcom and equipment names fell broadly; further AI-capex de-rating could overwhelm CPO.

Hygon Information
688041.SH
Domestic compute split

Why: Google's broader custom-silicon partner set shows ASIC demand remains strong, while domestic compute has local-order and supply-chain independence.

Trigger: The STAR chip index must stabilize, with Hygon outperforming Cambricon and SMIC on volume plus order or policy confirmation.

Risk: Simultaneous declines in Broadcom, AMD and Lam Research show sector de-rating can still overwhelm substitution narratives.

Shandong Gold
01787.HK
Gold-industry mapping

Why: Gold rose 9.23% with all 52 constituents higher in Moomoo's ranking, while other precious metals and mining gained 8.39%, giving A/H gold miners the clearest overnight read-through.

Trigger: Spot gold and SHFE gold stay firm while 01787.HK holds a higher open on volume and outperforms the HSI.

Risk: Precious metals already lead the ranking; a dollar rebound or fading haven premium could turn a higher open into a fast reversal.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesGold, silver, precious-metals mining and coking coal, plus HKEX and turnover-sensitive financials; verify breadth first in resource names.
WatchXiaomi EV/AI, domestic compute, internet platforms and growth support after the 10-year yield decline.
PressureComputer hardware, semiconductor equipment and materials, electronic components, memory and GPUs; crowded Korean AI hardware remains under liquidation.
SignalsSpot gold/SHFE gold and Shandong Gold volume, mapped SOXX price action, Xiaomi follow-through, HKEX's earnings gap, and whether the 10-year holds near 4.64%.

Logic Chain

Expanded Treasury long-bond buybacks pulled the 10-year yield to 4.64%, stabilizing US indexes and marginally supporting A/H valuations.
Moomoo's full ranking shows silver up 10.98%, gold up 9.23%, and other precious metals and mining up 8.39%, making resource havens the strongest overnight theme.
The same ranking shows semiconductor equipment and materials down 4.16% and computer hardware down 5.16%, confirming hardware pressure alongside SOXX's decline.
A/H mapping splits between precious-metals offense led by Shandong Gold and support tests in CPO, domestic compute and Hong Kong heavyweight earnings.
If gold and silver prices confirm with A/H miners on volume, the resource theme can extend; if precious metals fade while hardware keeps falling on volume, reduce chasing and rotate to cash-flow defense.

Risk Radar

Chip crowding spreads

SOXX fell 2.21% with Broadcom, AMD and equipment names broadly lower, threatening high-valuation A/H hardware.

Middle East energy escalation

The UAE trade halt and strait attacks can lift oil, inflation and Asian import costs.

Xiaomi margin volatility

Sequential improvement was rewarded, but year-over-year profit fell sharply and EV/AI initiatives remain loss-making.

HKEX non-recurring income

Record results include unlisted-equity valuation gains, while lower turnover would weaken durability.

Precious-metals gap reversal

Gold, silver and precious-metals mining already lead the industry ranking; a stronger dollar or fading haven demand could amplify a higher-open reversal.

Walmart fell more than 6% premarket despite a strong quarter because of cautious guidance, while Alibaba cloud grew 45% but profit and free cash flow weakened; Nordson, crypto platforms and select AI leaders showed relative strength.
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
期指
美股期指近乎平开，纳指小幅领先
AP在美东盘前显示，标普500期指近乎持平，道指期指跌0.1%，纳指期指涨0.1%。指数方向仍弱，开盘更可能由财报、油价和利率驱动内部轮动。
原油
阿联酋再响导弹警报，布油升至约93.90美元
阿联酋出现数周以来首次全国性导弹警报，特朗普威胁加大对伊朗经济压力；布油涨2.5%至约93.90美元，WTI涨2.8%至约86.72美元。能源现金流受益，但通胀和运输成本尾险上升。
利率
财政部扩大长债回购，10年期收益率回落至约4.68%
美国财政部计划至少把长久期国债回购规模翻倍，缓和债市供给压力；10年期收益率降至约4.68%，30年期约5.22%。利率回落支撑估值，但绝对水平仍高。
就业
初请失业金人数降至20.6万，劳动力市场仍稳
截至8月15日当周初请失业金人数由修正后的21.2万降至20.6万，低裁员延续。稳健就业有利消费韧性，却降低油价冲击下迅速转鸽的空间。
财报
Walmart业绩超预期，谨慎指引令盘前跌逾6%
Walmart调整后EPS为0.81美元，高于0.74美元预期，销售额1879.4亿美元也超预期；但美国同店销售增速降至六年最慢，三季度及全年利润指引低于市场，盘前跌逾6%，只作消费压力观察。
云计算
Alibaba云收入增45%，利润与现金流代价显著
Alibaba季度收入2690亿元、同比增9%，AI云与计算收入增45%、分部EBITA增133%；但集团调整后EBITA降30%、净利润降75%，自由现金流流出447亿元。盘前出现明显负反馈，不纳入多头推荐。
工业科技
Nordson盈利超预期并上调展望，盘前约涨8%
Nordson第三财季调整后EPS约3.25美元，高于约3.09美元一致预期，并上调全年指引；公开盘前报价约涨8.05%至334.44美元，价格和财报方向一致。
AI权重
大型AI权重温和反弹，但科技广度仍弱
公开盘前报价显示NVIDIA约涨0.58%、Meta约涨0.59%、Amazon约涨0.29%；与此同时科技板块近一日和近一周仍落后。当前是选择性承接，不是全面AI风险偏好修复。
加密
Coinbase与Strategy盘前同步走强
公开盘前报价显示Coinbase约涨3.59%、Strategy约涨3.66%，加密相关风险偏好强于大盘。若开盘后成交延续并保持相对强势，可形成独立事件交易；否则高波动回撤风险仍大。
医药科技
Moderna临床事件后盘前回落，获利兑现升温
前一交易日因癌症疫苗三期事件大涨后，公开盘前报价显示MRNA约跌4.57%。利好消息后的负价格反馈意味着不再追多，只保留为高波动风险与止跌观察。

盘前结论

财政部扩大长债回购令10年期收益率回落，纳指期指微涨，Nordson、Coinbase以及NVIDIA/Meta也出现盘前承接。但布油约93.90美元、稳健初请数据和30年期收益率仍高，使估值缓解有限。

Walmart业绩beat后因指引跌逾6%，Alibaba云增长强却因利润和自由现金流承压出现负反馈，均不作多头推荐。开盘基准情景是指数近乎平开，能源与精选科技/工业科技相对占优。

消费与高投入平台仍会分化；若布油继续上冲且10Y重返4.70%以上，纳指可能转弱。若NDSN守住财报缺口、NVDA/META保持相对强度且长债收益率稳定，选择性科技反弹可延续。

关键资产图

关键词云图

长债回购 油价冲击 NDSN财报强势 WMT负反馈 BABA利润压力 AI权重承接 加密链强势 期指分化 能源现金流 纳指微涨 MRNA回吐 盘后样本稀少
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。

重点个股推荐

Nordson
NDSN
财报强反馈

推荐理由：调整后EPS高于预期并上调全年展望，盘前约涨8.05%、明显强于工业科技和大盘；公开报价显示事件交易活跃。

触发因素：开盘后守住财报跳空区间、量能继续放大且相对工业与先进技术设备板块保持强势。

风险点：高开后获利回吐、订单前置或管理层对下半年需求更谨慎，都可能压缩估值扩张。

Coinbase
COIN
加密链强势

推荐理由：盘前约涨3.59%，与Strategy同步走强，价格反馈和板块共振均明显优于指数；盘前事件交易保持活跃。

触发因素：开盘后成交放大、守住盘前主要涨幅并继续强于金融科技与纳指，可确认动量延续。

风险点：高度依赖加密资产价格与交易量，若比特币回落或风险偏好转弱，涨幅可能快速反转。

NVIDIA
NVDA
AI权重承接

推荐理由：在科技板块近一周落后的背景下盘前仍约涨0.58%，相对半导体和纳指表现有承接，且8月26日财报构成下一验证点。

触发因素：开盘后放量站稳盘前区间、强于SMH与纳指，并由服务器/存储链同步止跌确认。

风险点：此前AI去杠杆尚未完全结束；若10Y回升或同业继续下跌，轻微盘前上涨不足以抵御估值压缩。

Meta Platforms
META
平台相对强势

推荐理由：盘前约涨0.59%，与NVIDIA并列大型科技中较强承接；相对科技板块一日和一周的弱广度表现更稳。

触发因素：开盘后成交维持、守住盘前涨幅并相对通信服务与纳指走强，可延续平台现金流溢价。

风险点：无新增硬催化，若广告需求、AI资本开支或监管担忧升温，当前小幅正反馈可能不足。

板块轮动看板

强势观察上游能源、Nordson代表的工业/先进技术设备、加密平台，以及NVIDIA/Meta等有盘前承接的大型科技。
事件驱动财政部长债回购、霍尔木兹局势、NDSN财报缺口、加密资产动量和今晚OSI Systems业绩。
压力方向Walmart及消费零售指引敏感股、Alibaba与高投入平台、利好后回吐的MRNA，以及高油价下的运输/航空。
验证信号布油是否突破94美元、10Y能否守住4.70%下方、NDSN/COIN量价延续，以及NVDA/META相对纳指强度。

逻辑链

阿联酋导弹警报和对伊朗压力升级推高油价，通胀尾险重新压制长久期估值。
财政部扩大长债回购使10年期收益率降至约4.68%，部分抵消油价冲击，因此指数期货接近平盘。
Walmart与Alibaba的负反馈说明市场惩罚谨慎指引和高投入现金流，而NDSN、COIN与部分AI权重获得相对溢价。
若油价稳定、长债收益率不再上行且强势股守住缺口，选择性科技/工业反弹可持续；反之转向能源与现金流防御。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下为基于已知一致预期、历史surprise、近期指引、卖方修正和行业景气的主观判断，不是确定事实。已检查Kiplinger/Briefing.com、TipRanks当天日历及公司IR；今晚可验证的大型科技公司样本不足。

高概率 · 暂无可验证大型科技样本已核对日历后，今晚最受关注的是零售商Ross Stores而非科技公司；Workday、Autodesk和Affirm均由公司IR确认在8月27日披露，不能挪作今晚样本。
中概率 · OSI Systems (OSIS) · 60%Kiplinger/Briefing.com列为8月20日盘后，市场一致预期EPS约3.77美元。上季营收创纪录、非GAAP EPS为2.60美元、积压订单约19亿美元且维持指引，支持中等偏高判断；政府合同节奏和中东冲突仍是风险。
低概率 · Domo (DOMO) / Flux Power (FLUX) · 条件观察TipRanks当天日历列出DOMO和FLUX，但页面未给出披露时点，运行时也未从公司IR确认今晚盘后，因此不赋正式beat概率。若临近收盘获得公司确认，DOMO因收入停滞与债务风险、FLUX因小市值和预测覆盖稀疏，均只归低置信度。

风险雷达

油价与霍尔木兹升级

布油约93.90美元，若导弹与制裁风险扩大，通胀、运输成本和长端利率可能同步上升。

Walmart指引拖累消费

季度beat仍盘前跌逾6%，表明市场更重视同店增速放缓与利润指引，零售链可能被重新定价。

Alibaba高投入现金流

AI云增45%却伴随净利润降75%和自由现金流流出447亿元；利好新闻后的负反馈只作观察，回避追多。

强势股高开回吐

NDSN与加密链盘前领先，但若开盘成交未能延续，财报缺口和动量涨幅可能快速收窄。

数据来源与时间点

来源：AP关于2026-08-20期指、原油、美债、汇率、Walmart与初请失业金；Alibaba、Nordson、Walmart、Ross Stores、Autodesk与Affirm公司IR；Kiplinger/Briefing.com、TipRanks及公开盘前报价关于日历、一致预期和价格反馈。抓取时间：2026-08-20 21:04 CST。公开文本未统一提供每只盘前股的精确成交量时不虚构数值，使用价格方向、相对板块强弱与事件活跃度降级判断。
entries.html_en:
Major News Summary
Futures
US futures are nearly flat, with the Nasdaq slightly ahead
AP showed S&P 500 futures nearly unchanged, Dow futures down 0.1% and Nasdaq futures up 0.1% before the US open. Index direction is weak, so earnings, oil and rates are more likely to drive internal rotation.
Oil
UAE missile alarms return as Brent reaches about $93.90
The UAE sounded its first nationwide missile alarm in weeks and President Trump threatened greater economic pressure on Iran. Brent rose 2.5% to about $93.90 and WTI 2.8% to about $86.72. Energy cash flow benefits, but inflation and transport-cost tail risks rise.
Rates
Treasury expands long-bond buybacks; the 10-year falls to about 4.68%
The US Treasury plans to at least double long-duration bond buybacks, easing supply pressure. The 10-year yield fell to about 4.68% and the 30-year to about 5.22%. Lower yields support valuations, but absolute levels remain high.
Labor
Jobless claims fall to 206,000 as the labor market stays firm
Claims for the week ended Aug. 15 fell to 206,000 from a revised 212,000. Low layoffs support consumer resilience but reduce room for a rapid dovish shift while oil is pressuring inflation.
Earnings
Walmart beats, but cautious guidance sends shares down more than 6%
Walmart posted adjusted EPS of $0.81 versus $0.74 expected and sales of $187.94 billion, also above consensus. US comparable-sales growth was the slowest in six years, while third-quarter and full-year profit guidance trailed expectations; treat the premarket decline as a consumer-risk signal.
Cloud
Alibaba cloud grows 45%, at a heavy profit and cash-flow cost
Alibaba revenue rose 9% to RMB269 billion, while AI Cloud and Compute revenue grew 45% and segment EBITA 133%. Group adjusted EBITA fell 30%, net income 75% and free cash flow was a RMB44.7 billion outflow. The negative premarket response excludes it from long ideas.
Industrial tech
Nordson beats and raises its outlook; shares gain about 8%
Nordson fiscal third-quarter adjusted EPS was about $3.25 versus roughly $3.09 expected, and the company raised full-year guidance. Public premarket quotes showed NDSN up about 8.05% to $334.44, aligning price with the earnings news.
AI leaders
Large AI leaders edge higher, but technology breadth remains weak
Public premarket quotes showed NVIDIA up about 0.58%, Meta 0.59% and Amazon 0.29%. Technology still lagged over the past day and week. This is selective support, not a broad AI-risk recovery.
Crypto
Coinbase and Strategy strengthen together before the open
Public premarket quotes showed Coinbase up about 3.59% and Strategy 3.66%, outperforming the index. If volume persists and relative strength holds after the open, the theme can trade independently; otherwise reversal risk remains high.
Biotech
Moderna retreats after its clinical-event surge
After the previous session's cancer-vaccine Phase 3 surge, public premarket quotes showed MRNA down about 4.57%. Negative feedback after favorable news removes it from long ideas; it remains only a high-volatility stabilization watch.

Pre-Market Conclusion

Expanded Treasury buybacks pulled the 10-year yield lower, Nasdaq futures edged up, and Nordson, Coinbase and NVIDIA/Meta found premarket support.Brent near $93.90, firm claims data and a still-high 30-year yield make the valuation relief limited.

Walmart fell more than 6% despite a beat because of guidance, while Alibaba's strong cloud growth was offset by profit and free-cash-flow pressure; neither belongs in long ideas.The base case is a nearly flat open with relative strength in energy and select technology/industrial technology.

Consumer and high-investment platforms should remain dispersed. Nasdaq could weaken if Brent keeps rising and the 10-year moves back above 4.70%; a selective tech bounce can continue if NDSN holds its gap, NVDA/META keep relative strength and long yields stabilize.

Key Asset Map

Nasdaq futures
+0.1%

Nearly flat

About 4.68%

-0.1%
Moderna premarket
About -4.57%

Keyword Cloud

Long-bond buybacks Oil shock NDSN earnings strength WMT negative feedback BABA profit pressure AI leader support Crypto-chain strength Futures split Energy cash flow Nasdaq edges up MRNA giveback Thin after-hours sample
BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not percentage moves.

Key Stock Ideas

Nordson
NDSN
Earnings strength

Why: Adjusted EPS beat expectations and full-year guidance rose; shares gained about 8.05% premarket, materially outperforming industrial tech and the index, with active event trading in public quotes.

Trigger: Hold the earnings-gap range after the open, with expanding volume and continued strength versus industrial and advanced-technology equipment peers.

Risk: Profit taking after a higher open, pulled-forward orders or a more cautious second-half demand message could compress the re-rating.

Coinbase
COIN
Crypto-chain strength

Why: Shares gained about 3.59% premarket alongside Strategy, with price action and sector confirmation both clearly stronger than the index; premarket event trading remained active.

Trigger: Expanding volume after the open, holding most of the premarket move and continued outperformance versus fintech and Nasdaq would confirm momentum.

Risk: The setup depends heavily on crypto prices and trading volumes; a Bitcoin reversal or weaker risk appetite can erase the gain quickly.

NVIDIA
NVDA
AI leader support

Why: Shares were up about 0.58% premarket despite technology lagging over the past week, showing support versus semiconductors and Nasdaq; Aug. 26 earnings are the next major test.

Trigger: Hold the premarket range on volume, outperform SMH and Nasdaq, and gain confirmation from stabilization in server and memory peers.

Risk: AI deleveraging is not fully resolved; a yield rebound or renewed peer selling can overwhelm a modest premarket gain.

Meta Platforms
META
Platform relative strength

Why: Shares gained about 0.59% premarket, joining NVIDIA among the better-supported large technology names and holding up better than weak one-day and one-week tech breadth.

Trigger: Maintain volume and the premarket gain after the open while outperforming communication services and Nasdaq.

Risk: There is no fresh hard catalyst; advertising demand, AI capex or regulatory concerns could make the modest positive feedback insufficient.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength watchUpstream energy, industrial/advanced technology equipment represented by Nordson, crypto platforms, and supported large tech such as NVIDIA and Meta.
Event-drivenTreasury long-bond buybacks, Hormuz developments, NDSN's earnings gap, crypto momentum and OSI Systems earnings tonight.
PressureWalmart and guidance-sensitive retailers, Alibaba and high-investment platforms, MRNA after its giveback, and transport/airlines exposed to high oil.
SignalsWhether Brent breaks $94, the 10-year stays below 4.70%, NDSN/COIN volume persists, and NVDA/META retain relative strength versus Nasdaq.

Logic Chain

UAE missile alarms and renewed pressure on Iran lift oil, restoring inflation tail risk and weighing on long-duration valuations.
Expanded Treasury long-bond buybacks pull the 10-year to about 4.68%, partly offsetting oil and leaving index futures near flat.
Negative feedback in Walmart and Alibaba punishes cautious guidance and investment-heavy cash flow, while NDSN, COIN and select AI leaders earn a relative premium.
If oil stabilizes, long yields stop rising and leaders hold their gaps, a selective tech/industrial bounce can persist; otherwise favor energy and cash-flow defense.

After-Hours Earnings Beat Probability

These are subjective judgments based on known consensus, historical surprises, recent guidance, sell-side revisions and industry conditions—not facts. Kiplinger/Briefing.com, TipRanks' daily calendar and company IR were checked; verifiable large-cap technology reporters are insufficient tonight.
